builtins.name: strlen
builtins.desc: Length of a string in bytes (not characters). For arrays use count().

builtins.name: count
builtins.desc: Number of elements in an array, or length of a string. Aliased by sizeof().

builtins.name: sizeof
builtins.desc: Alias of count(): elements in an array, bytes in a string.

builtins.name: strtoupper
builtins.desc: Converts every ASCII letter in the string to uppercase.

builtins.name: strtolower
builtins.desc: Converts every ASCII letter in the string to lowercase.

builtins.name: ucfirst
builtins.desc: Uppercases the first character of the string, leaves the rest untouched.

builtins.name: lcfirst
builtins.desc: Lowercases the first character of the string, leaves the rest untouched.

builtins.name: trim
builtins.desc: Strips leading and trailing whitespace (space, tab, newline, CR, NUL).

builtins.name: ltrim
builtins.desc: Strips leading whitespace only. Optional second argument: character list to strip.

builtins.name: rtrim
builtins.desc: Strips trailing whitespace only. Alias: chop(). Optional second argument: character list.

builtins.name: chop
builtins.desc: Alias of rtrim(): strips trailing whitespace.

builtins.name: strrev
builtins.desc: Reverses the string byte by byte.

builtins.name: str_repeat
builtins.desc: Repeats the string n times: str_repeat("ab", 3) -> "ababab".

builtins.name: str_pad
builtins.desc: Pads the string to the given length with a pad string (default " "), repeated on the right.

builtins.name: str_replace
builtins.desc: str_replace($search, $replace, $subject) — replaces every occurrence of $search in $subject.

builtins.name: substr
builtins.desc: substr($s, $start[, $len]) — extracts up to $len bytes starting at $start. Negative $start counts from the end; omitted $len means "to the end".

builtins.name: strstr
builtins.desc: Returns the part of $haystack from the first occurrence of $needle to the end, or false if not found.

builtins.name: strchr
builtins.desc: Alias of strstr().

builtins.name: strpos
builtins.desc: Byte position of the first occurrence of $needle in $haystack, or false when absent. Use !== false to test.

builtins.name: str_contains
builtins.desc: true when $needle occurs anywhere in $haystack (PHP 8 style, no position needed).

builtins.name: str_starts_with
builtins.desc: true when $haystack begins with $needle.

builtins.name: str_ends_with
builtins.desc: true when $haystack ends with $needle.

builtins.name: strcmp
builtins.desc: Byte-wise comparison: returns < 0, 0, or > 0 as $a sorts before, equal to, or after $b.

builtins.name: strncmp
builtins.desc: Like strcmp() but compares at most the first n bytes (third argument).

builtins.name: strncasecmp
builtins.desc: Case-insensitive strncmp(): first n bytes, returns -1/0/1 style result.

builtins.name: strcasecmp
builtins.desc: Case-insensitive strcmp().

builtins.name: explode
builtins.desc: explode($separator, $s) - splits the string at every separator into an array. The separator cannot be empty.

builtins.name: split
builtins.desc: Alias of explode().

builtins.name: implode
builtins.desc: Joins array elements with a glue string: implode($glue, $arr) or implode($arr).

builtins.name: join
builtins.desc: Alias of implode().

builtins.name: nl2br
builtins.desc:
Inserts "
" before every newline. Newlines are kept.

builtins.name: number_format
builtins.desc: Formats a number with grouped thousands: number_format($n[, $decimals[, $dec_point, $thousands_sep]]). Defaults: 0 decimals, ".", ",".

builtins.name: unset
builtins.desc: unset($arr["k"]) removes the key from the array; unset($var) is not needed for locals.

builtins.name: json_encode
builtins.desc: Encodes a value as JSON. Flags: JSON_PRETTY_PRINT (indented), JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES (keep /), JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK, JSON_FORCE_OBJECT. Combine with |.

builtins.name: json_encode_pretty
builtins.desc: json_encode() with JSON_PRETTY_PRINT pre-applied — convenience wrapper.

builtins.name: json_decode
builtins.desc: Decodes a JSON string into arrays/maps/scalars. Optional second argument ($assoc) is accepted for PHP compatibility and ignored.

builtins.name: preg_match
builtins.desc: preg_match($pattern, $subject[, &$matches]) — tries the pattern once on $subject. Returns 1 and fills $matches (index 0 = full match, 1..n = capture groups) on success, false on no match or bad pattern. Patterns use /.../ delimiters with flags i (case-insensitive), s (dotall), m (multiline).

builtins.name: preg_match_all
builtins.desc: preg_match_all($pattern, $subject[, &$matches]) — finds every non-overlapping match. Returns the number of matches and fills $matches with one array per match (each like preg_match's $matches).

builtins.name: preg_replace
builtins.desc: preg_replace($pattern, $replacement, $subject) — replaces every match. $replacement may reference captures as $1, $2, … Returns the modified string.

builtins.name: preg_split
builtins.desc: preg_split($pattern, $subject) — splits $subject at every match of the pattern and returns the pieces as an array.

builtins.name: preg_grep
builtins.desc: preg_grep($pattern, $array) — returns the elements of $array that match the pattern (keys are re-indexed 0..n).

builtins.name: sha256
builtins.desc: SHA-256 hash as 64-char hex. The general-purpose hash of this runtime.

builtins.name: hash_hmac
builtins.desc: hash_hmac("sha256", $data, $key) — keyed HMAC-SHA256 for signing messages.

builtins.name: password_hash
builtins.desc: Creates a salted password hash ($hphp$4096$salt$digest, PBKDF2-SHA256, 4096 rounds). Store this string; never store plain passwords.

builtins.name: password_verify
builtins.desc: password_verify($plain, $hash) — recomputes the digest with the hash's salt and compares timing-safely. true when the password matches.

builtins.name: random_bytes
builtins.desc: random_bytes($n) — $n cryptographically secure random bytes as a raw binary string (max 1024).

builtins.name: hash_equals
builtins.desc: Timing-safe string comparison for verifying hashes/signatures — always use it for secrets instead of ===.

builtins.name: mktime
builtins.desc: mktime($h, $m, $s, $month, $day, $year) — builds a Unix timestamp from local date/time parts.

builtins.name: strtotime
builtins.desc: Parses a date/time string ("2024-03-15 12:30:00", "2024-03-15", "12:30:00") into a Unix timestamp; 0 on failure.

builtins.name: http_post
builtins.desc: http_post($url, $body[, $headers]) — HTTP POST with the body string and optional header lines (e.g. "Content-Type: application/json"). Same return shape as http_get().

builtins.name: parse_url
builtins.desc: parse_url($url) — map with scheme, user, host, port, path, query, fragment; missing parts are empty strings, port defaults to 80/443.

builtins.name: http_build_query
builtins.desc: Turns a map into an urlencoded query string: ["a" => "x y"] → "a=x+y".

builtins.name: mysql_connect
builtins.desc: mysql_connect($host[, $port[, $user[, $pass[, $db]]]]) — opens a MySQL/MariaDB connection (native wire protocol, TCP). Returns a connection handle or false.

builtins.name: mysql_query
builtins.desc: mysql_query($conn, $sql) — runs a SELECT/SHOW and returns the rows as an array of maps (column name => value), false on error. For INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE use mysql_exec().

builtins.name: mysql_exec
builtins.desc: mysql_exec($conn, $sql) — runs a statement and returns the number of affected rows, false on error.

builtins.name: mysql_insert_id
builtins.desc: AUTO_INCREMENT value generated by the last INSERT on this connection.

builtins.name: mysql_close
builtins.desc: Closes the MySQL connection.

builtins.name: mysql_escape
builtins.desc: Escapes a string for safe embedding in SQL text (see the crypto group entry).

builtins.name: md5
builtins.desc: MD5 hash as 32-char hex. Fast but broken for security — checksums only.

builtins.name: sha1
builtins.desc: SHA-1 hash as 40-char hex. Also legacy — prefer sha256().

builtins.name: crc32
builtins.desc: CRC-32 checksum of the data as an integer — detects accidental corruption, not tampering.

builtins.name: base64_encode
builtins.desc: Encodes bytes as Base64 text (with = padding) — for safe transport in JSON, URLs-after-urlencode, etc.

builtins.name: base64_decode
builtins.desc: Decodes Base64 back to raw bytes. Invalid characters are skipped.

builtins.name: urlencode
builtins.desc: Encodes a string for use in a query string: space becomes +, reserved chars become %XX.

builtins.name: urldecode
builtins.desc: Inverse of urlencode().

builtins.name: htmlentities
builtins.desc: Converts & " ' < > (and more) to their HTML entities so the string is safe to embed as text.

builtins.name: htmlspecialchars
builtins.desc: Converts only the five HTML-critical characters & " ' < > to entities.

builtins.name: sprintf
builtins.desc: printf-style formatting that returns the string. Supports %d %s %f %x %o %b %e %c, width, precision and "-" left-align.

builtins.name: printf
builtins.desc: Like sprintf() but prints the result and returns its length.

builtins.name: vsprintf
builtins.desc: sprintf() with the arguments taken from an array.

builtins.name: ord
builtins.desc: Byte value of the first character of the string (0–255).

builtins.name: chr
builtins.desc: One-character string for the given byte value.

builtins.name: bin2hex
builtins.desc: Hexadecimal representation of the bytes, two chars per byte: bin2hex("AB") → "4142".

builtins.name: hex2bin
builtins.desc: Decodes a hexadecimal string back into raw bytes.

builtins.name: str_split
builtins.desc: str_split($s[, $len]) - cuts the string into chunks of $len characters (default 1) and returns them as an array.

builtins.name: ucwords
builtins.desc: Uppercases the first letter of every whitespace-separated word.

builtins.name: wordwrap
builtins.desc: Wraps a string to a given width by inserting breaks (default "\n") at word boundaries.

builtins.name: similar_text
builtins.desc: Number of matching characters between the two strings (a rough similarity measure).

builtins.name: levenshtein
builtins.desc: Edit distance (insertions, deletions, substitutions) between the two strings.

builtins.name: array
builtins.desc: Creates an array from the given values (or "key" => value pairs). Usually written as the [...] literal instead.

builtins.name: array_keys
builtins.desc: Returns all keys of the array as a new list array.

builtins.name: array_values
builtins.desc: Returns all values of the array as a freshly indexed list (0..n-1).

builtins.name: array_merge
builtins.desc: Merges two or more arrays; later arrays overwrite string keys of earlier ones, numeric keys are appended.

builtins.name: array_slice
builtins.desc: array_slice($arr, $offset[, $length]) — extracts a section of the array. Negative $offset counts from the end.

builtins.name: array_reverse
builtins.desc: Returns the array with elements in reverse order.

builtins.name: array_sum
builtins.desc: Sum of all numeric values in the array (non-numerics count as 0).

builtins.name: array_product
builtins.desc: Product of all numeric values in the array.

builtins.name: array_unique
builtins.desc: Removes duplicate values, keeping the first occurrence of each.

builtins.name: in_array
builtins.desc: in_array($needle, $haystack) — true when the value occurs in the array.

builtins.name: array_key_exists
builtins.desc: true when $key exists in the array (also for string keys and null values).

builtins.name: isset
builtins.desc: isset($arr["k"]) — true when the key exists and the value is not null.

builtins.name: range
builtins.desc: range($start, $end) — list of integers from $start to $end inclusive (also counts down).

builtins.name: compact
builtins.desc: Builds an array from the named local variables: compact("a", "b") → ["a" => $a, "b" => $b].

builtins.name: array_column
builtins.desc: array_column($rows, $col) — picks one column out of an array of maps, indexed 0..n.

builtins.name: array_chunk
builtins.desc: array_chunk($arr, $size) — splits the array into chunks of at most $size elements.

builtins.name: array_pad
builtins.desc: array_pad($arr, $size, $value) — grows the array to $size by filling with $value (negative size pads left).

builtins.name: array_replace
builtins.desc: array_replace($a, $b, …) — elements of later arrays overwrite those of earlier ones, keys preserved.

builtins.name: array_fill_keys
builtins.desc: array_fill_keys(["a","b"], $v) — map with those keys, each mapped to $v.

builtins.name: array_key_first
builtins.desc: First key of the array (null when empty).

builtins.name: array_key_last
builtins.desc: Last key of the array (null when empty).

builtins.name: usort
builtins.desc: usort($arr, $cmp) — sorts by value in place using a comparator closure returning -1/0/1.

builtins.name: uasort
builtins.desc: usort with key association preserved (for maps).

builtins.name: uksort
builtins.desc: Sorts the map in place by key using a comparator closure.

builtins.name: array_walk
builtins.desc: array_walk($arr, $fn) — calls $fn($value, $key) for every element; the closure may modify $value via a by-ref parameter.

builtins.name: array_walk_recursive
builtins.desc: Like array_walk() but descends into nested arrays.

builtins.name: substr_count
builtins.desc: Counts how many times $needle occurs in $haystack.

builtins.name: str_shuffle
builtins.desc: Randomly shuffles the characters of the string (not cryptographically secure).

builtins.name: strip_tags
builtins.desc: Removes HTML and PHP tags from the string.

builtins.name: html_entity_decode
builtins.desc: Inverse of htmlentities(): "&" becomes "&" again.

builtins.name: array_map
builtins.desc: array_map($fn, $arr[, $arr2, …]) — applies the closure to every element and returns the results. With several arrays the closure gets one argument per array.

builtins.name: array_filter
builtins.desc: array_filter($arr[, $fn]) — keeps elements where $fn returns true; without $fn keeps all truthy elements. Keys are preserved.

builtins.name: array_reduce
builtins.desc: array_reduce($arr, $fn[, $initial]) — folds the array left-to-right: $fn($carry, $item).

builtins.name: array_flip
builtins.desc: Swaps keys and values: ["a" => 1] becomes [1 => "a"].

builtins.name: array_fill
builtins.desc: array_fill($start, $num, $value) — $num copies of $value starting at index $start.

builtins.name: array_combine
builtins.desc: array_combine($keys, $values) — builds a map using one array as keys and the other as values.

builtins.name: array_diff
builtins.desc: array_diff($a, $b, …) — values of $a that do not appear in any other array.

builtins.name: array_intersect
builtins.desc: array_intersect($a, $b, …) — values of $a that appear in all other arrays.

builtins.name: array_push
builtins.desc: Appends one or more values to the end of the array; returns the new count. $arr[] = v is preferred.

builtins.name: array_pop
builtins.desc: Removes and returns the last element of the array (null when empty).

builtins.name: array_shift
builtins.desc: Removes and returns the first element, re-indexing the rest (null when empty).

builtins.name: array_unshift
builtins.desc: Prepends one or more values to the front of the array; returns the new count.

builtins.name: array_splice
builtins.desc: array_splice($arr, $offset[, $length[, $replacement]]) — removes a section and optionally replaces it; returns the removed elements.

builtins.name: shuffle
builtins.desc: Randomly reorders the array in place (not cryptographically secure).

builtins.name: sort
builtins.desc: Sorts the array in place by value, ascending, re-indexing 0..n.

builtins.name: rsort
builtins.desc: Sorts the array in place by value, descending, re-indexing.

builtins.name: ksort
builtins.desc: Sorts the map in place by key, ascending, keeping key/value association.

builtins.name: krsort
builtins.desc: Sorts the map in place by key, descending.

builtins.name: asort
builtins.desc: Sorts the map in place by value, ascending, keeping key/value association.

builtins.name: array_search
builtins.desc: Returns the key of the first element equal to $needle, or false when not found.

builtins.name: end
builtins.desc: Advances the internal pointer to the last element and returns its value.

builtins.name: reset
builtins.desc: Rewinds the internal pointer to the first element and returns its value.

builtins.name: max
builtins.desc: Largest of the given numbers or array elements (variadic).

builtins.name: min
builtins.desc: Smallest of the given numbers or array elements (variadic).

builtins.name: rand
builtins.desc: rand() → pseudo-random int, or rand($min, $max) within the inclusive range (not secure).

builtins.name: mt_rand
builtins.desc: Mersenne-Twister pseudo-random: mt_rand() or mt_rand($min, $max) (faster, still not secure).

builtins.name: srand
builtins.desc: Seeds rand() — only useful to get reproducible sequences.

builtins.name: mt_srand
builtins.desc: Seeds mt_rand() — only useful to get reproducible sequences.

builtins.name: random_int
builtins.desc: Cryptographically secure random integer in [$min, $max]. Prefer this over rand().

builtins.name: fgetc
builtins.desc: Reads a single character from a file handle.

builtins.name: abs
builtins.desc: Absolute value; keeps the input type (int stays int, float stays float).

builtins.name: round
builtins.desc: round($n[, $precision[, $mode]]) — rounds to $precision decimals (default 0). $mode: PHP_ROUND_HALF_UP (default), _HALF_DOWN, _HALF_EVEN, _HALF_ODD.

builtins.name: floor
builtins.desc: Largest integer value ≤ $n, returned as float.

builtins.name: ceil
builtins.desc: Smallest integer value ≥ $n, returned as float.

builtins.name: sqrt
builtins.desc: Square root as float.

builtins.name: pow
builtins.desc: pow($base, $exp) — $base raised to $exp.

builtins.name: intdiv
builtins.desc: Integer division truncating toward zero: intdiv(7, 2) === 3.

builtins.name: fmod
builtins.desc: Floating-point remainder of $x / $y.

builtins.name: sin
builtins.desc: Sine of the angle in radians.

builtins.name: cos
builtins.desc: Cosine of the angle in radians.

builtins.name: tan
builtins.desc: Tangent of the angle in radians.

builtins.name: atan
builtins.desc: Arctangent in radians.

builtins.name: atan2
builtins.desc: Angle of the point (y, x) — note the argument order.

builtins.name: asin
builtins.desc: Arcsine in radians.

builtins.name: acos
builtins.desc: Arccosine in radians.

builtins.name: log
builtins.desc: Natural logarithm (ln). Optional second argument is the base.

builtins.name: log2
builtins.desc: Binary logarithm (base 2).

builtins.name: log10
builtins.desc: Common logarithm (base 10).

builtins.name: exp
builtins.desc: e raised to the given power.

builtins.name: is_nan
builtins.desc: true for the special Not-a-Number float value.

builtins.name: is_finite
builtins.desc: true when the float is neither infinite nor NaN.

builtins.name: is_infinite
builtins.desc: true for ±infinity.

builtins.name: pi
builtins.desc: Returns π as float. The constant M_PI is equivalent.

builtins.name: M_PI
builtins.desc: The constant π as a callable fallback — prefer the constant.

builtins.name: deg2rad
builtins.desc: Converts degrees to radians.

builtins.name: rad2deg
builtins.desc: Converts radians to degrees.

builtins.name: hypot
builtins.desc: hypot($a, $b) — length of the hypotenuse sqrt(a² + b²), overflow-safe.

builtins.name: lcg_value
builtins.desc: Pseudo-random float in [0, 1) from the combined linear congruential generator (not secure).

builtins.name: is_int
builtins.desc: true when the value is an integer. Aliases: is_integer().

builtins.name: is_integer
builtins.desc: Alias of is_int().

builtins.name: is_float
builtins.desc: true when the value is a float.

builtins.name: is_string
builtins.desc: true when the value is a string.

builtins.name: is_bool
builtins.desc: true when the value is true or false.

builtins.name: is_array
builtins.desc: true when the value is an array or map.

builtins.name: is_null
builtins.desc: true when the value is null.

builtins.name: is_numeric
builtins.desc: true when the value is a number or a numeric string like "42" or "3.5".

builtins.name: intval
builtins.desc: Converts to int, truncating floats and parsing the leading integer of strings (0 when not numeric).

builtins.name: floatval
builtins.desc: Converts to float. Alias: doubleval().

builtins.name: doubleval
builtins.desc: Alias of floatval().

builtins.name: strval
builtins.desc: Converts the value to its string representation.

builtins.name: boolval
builtins.desc: Converts to bool using PHP truthiness (0, "", "0", [], null are false).

builtins.name: gettype
builtins.desc: Type name as a string: "int", "float", "string", "bool", "array", "null", …

builtins.name: var_dump
builtins.desc: Prints type and value of one or more expressions, recursively for arrays — the main debugging tool.

builtins.name: print_r
builtins.desc: Human-readable dump of a value (arrays indented). Returns the text instead of printing it.

builtins.name: var_export
builtins.desc: Returns a string of PHP code that would recreate the value.

builtins.name: serialize
builtins.desc: Serializes the value into a storable string (HolyPHP's own format — do not exchange with PHP's).

builtins.name: unserialize
builtins.desc: Restores a value serialized by serialize(). Never unserialize untrusted input.

builtins.name: readline
builtins.desc: Prints the prompt and reads one line from stdin (for interactive scripts).

builtins.name: file_get_contents
builtins.desc: Reads an entire file into a string. Throws when the file cannot be opened.

builtins.name: file_put_contents
builtins.desc: file_put_contents($path, $data[, $flags]) — writes the string/binary data to the file. Flag PHP_FILE_APPEND appends instead of truncating.

builtins.name: file_exists
builtins.desc: true when a file or directory exists at the path.

builtins.name: is_dir
builtins.desc: true when the path is an existing directory.

builtins.name: filesize
builtins.desc: Size of the file in bytes.

builtins.name: mkdir
builtins.desc: mkdir($path[, $recursive]) — creates a directory; with $recursive true it creates parents too.

builtins.name: rmdir
builtins.desc: Removes an (empty) directory.

builtins.name: unlink
builtins.desc: Deletes a file. Returns true on success.

builtins.name: rename
builtins.desc: Renames or moves a file (also across directories).

builtins.name: copy
builtins.desc: Copies the file's contents to a new path.

builtins.name: fgets
builtins.desc: Reads one line (up to and including the newline) from a file handle. Returns false at end of file.

builtins.name: fwrite
builtins.desc: fwrite($handle, $data) — writes the data; returns the number of bytes written.

builtins.name: fopen
builtins.desc: fopen($path, $mode) — opens a file handle for streaming ("r" read, "w" truncate+write, "a" append, "rb"/"wb" binary).

builtins.name: fclose
builtins.desc: Closes a file handle opened by fopen(). Always do this for written files.

builtins.name: scandir
builtins.desc: Lists the entries of a directory as an array (including "." and "..").

builtins.name: dirname
builtins.desc: Directory part of a path: dirname("a/b/c.txt") → "a/b".

builtins.name: basename
builtins.desc: File name part of a path: basename("a/b/c.txt") → "c.txt". Optional second argument strips a suffix.

builtins.name: pathinfo
builtins.desc: pathinfo($path) — map with dirname, basename, extension and filename.

builtins.name: realpath
builtins.desc: Resolves relative parts and returns the canonical absolute path (false when it does not exist).

builtins.name: is_file
builtins.desc: true when the path is an existing regular file.

builtins.name: is_readable
builtins.desc: true when the file exists and can be read.

builtins.name: is_writable
builtins.desc: true when the file exists and can be written.

builtins.name: touch
builtins.desc: Creates the file if missing, otherwise updates its modification time.

builtins.name: glob
builtins.desc: glob($pattern) - file paths matching a shell wildcard pattern ("*.hphp", "src/*/*.c") as an array.

builtins.name: sys_get_temp_dir
builtins.desc: Path of the system's temporary directory.

builtins.name: checkdate
builtins.desc: checkdate($month, $day, $year) — true when the date is a valid calendar date (knows leap years).

builtins.name: fread
builtins.desc: fread($handle, $max) — reads up to $max bytes from a file handle.

builtins.name: feof
builtins.desc: true when the file handle has reached end of file.

builtins.name: http_get
builtins.desc: http_get($url) — performs an HTTP GET (http:// only, no TLS) and returns ["status" => 200, "body" => …, "contentType" => …], or false on failure.

builtins.name: http_request
builtins.desc: http_request($url, $method, $body, $headers) — generic HTTP request for custom verbs (PUT, DELETE, …).

builtins.name: stream_socket_server
builtins.desc: stream_socket_server("host:port") — binds and listens on a TCP socket; returns a server handle (or -1).

builtins.name: stream_socket_client
builtins.desc: stream_socket_client("host:port") — connects to a TCP server; returns a socket handle (or -1).

builtins.name: stream_socket_accept
builtins.desc: Accepts one incoming connection from a server handle (blocks until a client arrives).

builtins.name: stream_socket_accept2
builtins.desc: Like stream_socket_accept() but with a timeout in milliseconds.

builtins.name: stream_set_blocking
builtins.desc: Switches a socket handle between blocking and non-blocking mode.

builtins.name: stream_ready
builtins.desc: Checks which of the given socket handles are readable (select-style); returns the ready handles as an array.

builtins.name: stream_recv
builtins.desc: stream_recv($sock[, $max]) — receives up to $max bytes (default 4096) from the socket as a string.

builtins.name: stream_send
builtins.desc: stream_send($sock, $data) — sends the string over the socket; returns the bytes sent.

builtins.name: stream_eof
builtins.desc: true when the peer closed the connection.

builtins.name: stream_peer
builtins.desc: IP:port of the remote end of the socket.

builtins.name: stream_close
builtins.desc: Closes a socket handle.

builtins.name: getcwd
builtins.desc: Current working directory of the process.

builtins.name: decbin
builtins.desc: Integer to binary string: decbin(10) -> "1010".

builtins.name: decoct
builtins.desc: Integer to octal string: decoct(8) -> "10".

builtins.name: dechex
builtins.desc: Integer to hexadecimal string: dechex(255) -> "ff".

builtins.name: bindec
builtins.desc: Parses a binary string ("1010") into an integer.

builtins.name: octdec
builtins.desc: Parses an octal string ("777") into an integer.

builtins.name: hexdec
builtins.desc: Parses a hexadecimal string ("ff") into an integer.

builtins.name: getenv
builtins.desc: Value of the environment variable (empty string when unset).

builtins.name: putenv
builtins.desc: putenv("NAME=value") — sets an environment variable for this process.

builtins.name: php_uname
builtins.desc: Operating system description string, e.g. "Windows NT …".

builtins.name: phpversion
builtins.desc: Version of the HolyPHP runtime (duplicate entry kept for lookup stability).

builtins.name: php_sapi_name
builtins.desc: Interface name — "cli" for command line builds.

builtins.name: microtime
builtins.desc: Current time as float seconds with microsecond precision (e.g. 1691234567.1234).

builtins.name: hrtime
builtins.desc: High-resolution monotonic counter in nanoseconds — use for benchmarking, immune to clock changes.

builtins.name: memory_get_usage
builtins.desc: Bytes currently allocated by the runtime's heap.

builtins.name: memory_get_peak_usage
builtins.desc: Largest amount of memory the process has used so far.

builtins.name: gc_collect_cycles
builtins.desc: Forces a garbage-collection pass; returns the number of freed objects.

builtins.name: sys_getloadavg
builtins.desc: System load average as an array (platform-dependent, mostly informational).

builtins.name: php_logo_guid
builtins.desc: Returns the logo identifier (kept for PHP-compat novelty; safe to ignore).

builtins.name: date
builtins.desc: date($format[, $timestamp]) — formats the timestamp (default: now) according to $format. Supported: Y y m n d j H G i s a A D l M N W t L U.

builtins.name: time
builtins.desc: Current Unix timestamp — seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

builtins.name: usleep
builtins.desc: Pauses the program for the given number of microseconds.

builtins.name: sleep
builtins.desc: Pauses the program for the given number of seconds.

builtins.name: exit
builtins.desc: Terminates the program immediately with the given exit code (default 0). Alias: die().

builtins.name: die
builtins.desc: Alias of exit().

builtins.name: php_sapi
builtins.desc: Alias of php_sapi_name().

builtins.name: ui_dispatch
builtins.desc: Runs one iteration of the UI event loop (for manual/embedded loops). Prefer ui_run_main().

builtins.name: ui_run_main
builtins.desc: Starts the UI event loop — call once after building your windows; blocks until the last window closes.

builtins.name: ui_quit
builtins.desc: Ends the UI event loop and closes the application.

builtins.name: ui_window
builtins.desc: ui_window($title, $x, $y, $w, $h) — creates a window; returns its handle.

builtins.name: ui_show
builtins.desc: ui_show($handle, $visible) — shows or hides a window/control.

builtins.name: ui_title
builtins.desc: Sets the window title.

builtins.name: ui_size
builtins.desc: ui_size($handle, $w, $h) — resizes a window/control.

builtins.name: ui_pos
builtins.desc: ui_pos($handle, $x, $y) — moves a window/control.

builtins.name: ui_close
builtins.desc: Destroys a window/control handle.

builtins.name: ui_alive
builtins.desc: true while the window/event loop is still running.

builtins.name: ui_add
builtins.desc: ui_add($parent, $kind, $text, $x, $y, $w, $h) — adds a control to a window. $kind: 1=window 2=button 3=label 4=input 5=checkbox 6=list 7=combo 8=progress 9=slider 10=group 11=tab 12=panel 13=menu 14=menuitem 15=picture. Returns the control handle.

builtins.name: ui_set
builtins.desc: Sets the text of a control (label, button, input value, …).

builtins.name: ui_get
builtins.desc: Reads the current text/value of a control (e.g. an input field).

builtins.name: ui_enable
builtins.desc: ui_enable($handle, $enabled) — enables/disables a control.

builtins.name: ui_move
builtins.desc: Moves a control inside its parent.

builtins.name: ui_focus
builtins.desc: Gives the keyboard focus to a control.

builtins.name: ui_items
builtins.desc: Number of items in a list/combo control.

builtins.name: ui_remove
builtins.desc: ui_remove($handle, $index) — removes an item from a list/combo.

builtins.name: ui_clear
builtins.desc: Removes all items from a list/combo (or text from an input).

builtins.name: ui_ctrl_show
builtins.desc: Shows/hides a single control.

builtins.name: ui_selected
builtins.desc: Index of the selected item in a list/combo (-1 when none).

builtins.name: ui_select
builtins.desc: ui_select($handle, $index) — selects an item programmatically.

builtins.name: ui_item_text
builtins.desc: Text of the item at the given index.

builtins.name: ui_check_get
builtins.desc: true when a checkbox is checked.

builtins.name: ui_check_set
builtins.desc: ui_check_set($handle, $checked) — sets a checkbox.

builtins.name: ui_progress
builtins.desc: ui_progress($handle, $percent) — sets a progress bar (0–100).

builtins.name: ui_slider_get
builtins.desc: Current value of a slider.

builtins.name: ui_slider_set
builtins.desc: Sets a slider's value.

builtins.name: ui_bg
builtins.desc: ui_bg($handle, $color) — background color (RGB int, e.g. 0xFF0000 for red).

builtins.name: ui_fg
builtins.desc: Foreground (text) color as RGB int.

builtins.name: ui_font
builtins.desc: ui_font($handle, $size[, $bold[, $italic[, $family]]]) — sets a control's font.

builtins.name: ui_menu
builtins.desc: Creates a menu bar / menu for a window.

builtins.name: ui_menu_item
builtins.desc: Appends an item to a menu; returns its handle (for ui_on callbacks).

builtins.name: ui_menu_sep
builtins.desc: Appends a separator line to a menu.

builtins.name: ui_menu_check
builtins.desc: ui_menu_check($handle, $checked) — checkable menu item state.

builtins.name: ui_on
builtins.desc: ui_on($handle, $event, $callback) — registers a closure for events: "click", "change", "select", "close", … The closure receives event-specific arguments.

builtins.name: ui_timer
builtins.desc: ui_timer($ms, $callback) — runs the closure every $ms milliseconds until ui_quit().

builtins.name: ui_msg
builtins.desc: ui_msg($win, $title, $text[, $type]) — message box. $type: 0=info 1=warning 2=error 3=question.

builtins.name: ui_open_file
builtins.desc: Opens the platform file-open dialog; returns the chosen path or false.

builtins.name: ui_save_file
builtins.desc: Opens the platform save-file dialog; returns the chosen path or false.

builtins.name: ui_pick_folder
builtins.desc: Folder-picker dialog; returns the path or false.

builtins.name: ui_pick_color
builtins.desc: Color-picker dialog; returns the RGB int or false.

builtins.name: ui_clip_set
builtins.desc: Copies text to the system clipboard.

builtins.name: ui_clip_get
builtins.desc: Reads text from the system clipboard.

builtins.name: malloc
builtins.desc: unsafe: allocates n bytes of raw memory; returns a pointer for memcpy/memset/ffi. Must be freed with free().

builtins.name: free
builtins.desc: unsafe: frees a raw pointer obtained from FFI. Wrong use corrupts memory — this is why it needs an unsafe block.

builtins.name: memcpy
builtins.desc: unsafe: copies $n bytes from one raw address to another.

builtins.name: memset
builtins.desc: unsafe: fills $n bytes at an address with a byte value.

builtins.name: ffi_load
builtins.desc: unsafe: ffi_load("mylib.dll") — loads a shared library for direct native calls. Returns a library handle or false.

builtins.name: ffi_call
builtins.desc: unsafe: ffi_call($lib, "symbol") — resolves an exported function in a loaded library; call the result with the documented signature.

builtins.name: heap_dump
builtins.desc: Returns a debug dump of the runtime heap (allocation count, sizes).
